subject.title: [Feature] Per-kind verbose output: commentary/narration without tool summaries

question: Should narration-only output be transient progress-preview content, durable standalone chat history, or both?
rationale: The existing progress configuration can represent transient commentary independently, while durable narration would expand the public command, configuration, and session contract.

options.title: Fix transient commentary
options.body: Make Mattermost honor `streaming.progress.commentary` independently of tool progress and document the narration-only preview configuration.

options.title: Add durable commentary too
options.body: Also add `/verbose commentary` when narration must persist as standalone chat messages without tool summaries.

options.title: Keep current modes
options.body: Retain the existing coarse durable verbosity modes and treat progress previews as the only narration-specific surface.

recommendation.title: Fix transient commentary
recommendation.body: Make Mattermost honor `streaming.progress.commentary` independently of tool progress and document the narration-only preview configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and refined the current durable-commentary behavior and introduced the shared progress-draft architecture.
